five-star prices, one-star execution
Apr 2026 • Friends
it was a poor experience. you would expect a beach bar at the intercontinental to be a high-end experience, but it’s luxury in price only. the cocktails are mediocre at best, and the service is honestly terrible. the issue isn't necessarily the individual servers, but rather a systematic lack of training. nobody could explain the menu and drinks took ages to arrive.
they also serve everything in plastic cups. while they explained this is a safety measure due to strong winds, it’s still not what i expect from a five-star brand. what makes it even more frustrating is that the rest of the hotel provides the excellent service you'd expect from a luxury stay. there is just a massive, disappointing gap between this pool bar and the standards of the rest of the property.

DELMAR POOL BAR
Oct 2025 • Family
Delmar Pool Bar is an amazing place to unwind and enjoy a perfect coastal vibe. The poolside view overlooking the ocean is absolutely stunning, creating a relaxing yet vibrant atmosphere. The cocktails are beautifully crafted, refreshing, and full of flavor — especially their signature drinks. The staff is friendly, attentive, and always ready to help with a smile.
